neighbors.sift-codebase-audit: Use when asked to audit a codebase for simplification or refactoring opportunities, review structural complexity or tech debt, or produce a prioritized simplification plan. Read-only, whole-repository.
neighbors.systematic-debugging: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes.
neighbors.security-audit: Security guidance and vulnerability review for codebases, APIs, services, and CLI tools. Use for security questions, focused reviews, security audits, or pen tests.
neighbors.code-review: Review the current diff, or a PR, branch, or path, for correctness bugs.
neighbors.simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, and efficiency cleanups, then apply the fixes.
neighbors.bug-triage-score: Use when bugs are found during code review, debugging, audits, or testing, to decide whether each one gets fixed now or just filed as an issue.
neighbors.test-driven-development: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code.
neighbors.trace: Use when verifying a repository against its authoritative spec: spec-to-code audits, implementation-completeness reviews, release verification.
neighbors.frontend-design: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces. Use when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications.

named-audit.request: Audit this repo for implicit state machines.

refunded-and-shipped.request: Some orders show as refunded and shipped at the same time. Work out how the code lets that happen and where else it can.

flag-cluster.request: Half our components carry isLoading, isError and hasSubmitted. Which of them can land in combinations that make no sense?

scattered-status.request: The status column on subscriptions gets written from about nine places. Is that a problem, and what should we do about it?

stuck-records.request: Uploads get stuck in 'assembling' forever for a few users a week, and jobs sometimes run twice after a cancel. I think our lifecycles are a mess. Take a look across the codebase.

find-and-fix.request: Find the state bugs in this repo and fix them.

build-new-machine.request: Build a traffic light simulator page driven by a state machine.

failing-test.request: tests/test_checkout.py fails with KeyError: 'cart_total_cents'. Fix it.

pr-review.request: Review my open PR for bugs before I merge.

simplify-audit.request: Audit the codebase for tech debt and tell me what to simplify first.

security.request: Is our login flow open to session fixation?

dark-mode.request: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page.
